name: TasksRemovedTasksResult
description: tasks/result is removed in v2 and MUST reject with -32601

name: TasksRemovedTasksList
description: tasks/list is removed in v2 and MUST reject with -32601

name: TasksServerDirectedCreationNoHint
description: tools/call with no client `task` hint param MUST still produce CreateTaskResult for task-supporting tools

name: TasksLegacyTaskParamIgnored
description: tools/call with legacy `task` param against a sync tool MUST NOT error and MUST NOT be promoted to a task

name: TasksImmediateResultShortcut
description: For a fast operation, a task-supporting tool MAY skip task creation and return a sync ToolResult; either path is valid

name: TasksResultTypeCompleteOnNonTaskResponses
description: Sync tools/call, tasks/get, tasks/update ack, and tasks/cancel ack MUST all carry resultType:"complete"

name: TasksStrongConsistencyImmediateGet
description: tasks/get issued immediately after CreateTaskResult arrives MUST resolve (server MUST NOT return CreateTaskResult before the task is durably created)

name: TasksGetUnknownTaskIdRejected
description: tasks/get for a taskId the server does not recognize MUST return -32602
errorMessage: expected -32602; got -32601 (if the server is otherwise compliant, verify it does not validate other dimensions — routing headers, _meta, params shape — before method dispatch)

name: WireSchemaValid
description: Every JSON-RPC message the implementation sent is valid per the spec JSON schema for the negotiated spec version
